name: Hunter (Optimal Shenanigans Games)
body:
Alignment: Any neutral

Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s hunter class levels learns all hunter spells their mentor knows, adding them to their list of spells known for the day. The apprentice casts spells learned from a hunter mentor as divine spells. Spells cast this way use the apprentice’s Charisma regardless of what ability their mentor uses to modify their spells. This ability does not allow an apprentice to cast spell they cannot learn due to their Charisma score or level. Apprentices treat spells learned this way just as any other spontaneous spell caster would their spells known. Your caster level is equal to your apprentice level, and your save DCs and concentration checks are Charisma-based. You’re considered to have the druid and ranger spell lists for purposes of spell completion items and spell trigger items.

Advanced Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s hunter class levels and chooses hunter for their advanced mentorship ability for the day may choose to command their mentor’s animal companion or gain the hunter’s animal focus class feature. If the apprentice chooses to command their mentor’s companion, the animal companion may make a single standard or move action on each of the apprentices turns. If the apprentice instead chooses the animal focus, the apprentice gains the hunter’s animal focus class feature as a hunter whose level is equal to her apprentice level minus 3. At level 11, an apprentice whose chosen the hunter’s animal focus also gains the hunter’s second animal focus class feature.

Cooperation Power

Key ability: Wisdom

Apprentices who study a mentor’s hunter class levels and chooses hunter for their cooperation power may, as a standard action, spend a cooperation point to grant themselves or an ally within reach the hunter’s woodland stride class feature for 1 minute. If used on an ally who already possesses the woodland stride class feature, instead they gain a +10 bonus to their land speed when moving through undergrowth.
